newsitem.title: UK: AEI says net income up 33pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: AEI says net income up 33pct in 1996.

text.p: Air Express International Corp (AEI)said it recorded a net income for 1996 of $38.5 million, up 33 percent on 1995.

Gross revenues rose nine percent last year to $1.335 billion with all of its major services contributing -- airfreight forwarding, ocean freight forwarding, customs brokerage and other services, the company said in a statement issued here.
Net revenues for the year were 18 percent up at $432.43 million with operating profit gaining 24 percent to $58.76 million.

Guenter Rohrmann, president and chief operating officer, added: "Our strategy of providing global logistics services has continued to pay dividends as AEI close another year of record revenues and earnings. Worldwide operations continued to perform well in 1996 with our foreign operations reporting significant gains over 1995."

AEI is a logistics company offering international air and ocean forwarding, warehousing and distribution customs brokerage and information services through its worldwide network of 600 locations in 135 countries. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
